project_info.name: Sat (sales assumptions tool)
project_info.description: Guided financial sales and cost assumption web app with a 12-month projection horizon for business owners presenting cash flow assumptions to lenders.

key_features_and_views.landing_hero: Clean intro banner with app description, quick preset launcher (Retail, SaaS, Restaurant, Services), and 'Start Guided Wizard' CTA button.

guided_wizard.progress_bar: Sticky step indicator with 5 key phases (1. Business Profile -> 2. Products & Categories -> 3. Unit Sales Projections -> 4. Per-Unit Direct Costs -> 5. Summary & Analysis).
guided_wizard.step_1_business_profile: Industry selection, business model, currency symbol ($), starting projection month, and AI auto-suggest assumptions button.
guided_wizard.step_2_product_catalog: Dynamic item management. Auto-detects if >10 products and prompts category grouping (Sales Category 1, Sales Category 2...). Price per unit inputs.
guided_wizard.step_3_sales_volume: 12-month unit volume inputs per product with quick tools: Bulk Fill, Linear Growth Trend (+% / mo), Seasonality Patterns (Q4 Peak, Summer Surge), and AI Auto-Fill.
guided_wizard.step_4_cost_assumptions: Per-unit Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) / direct cost input with gross margin target suggestions.
guided_wizard.step_5_wizard_review: Validation summary, instant calculation check, and button to open full spreadsheet view.

spreadsheet_views.sales_table: 12-month horizontally scrollable table with sticky category/product name columns, dark header row (#111827), olive/dark-yellow category band rows (#EEF3E2), unit price, monthly unit volume columns (Jan-Dec), and Annual Total Revenue.
spreadsheet_views.cost_table: Matching table structure showing Cost per Unit and monthly total direct cost projection.
spreadsheet_views.margin_summary_table: Dynamic row showing Total Revenue, Total Direct Costs, Gross Margin ($), and Gross Margin (%).

charts: Monthly Revenue vs. Direct Costs (Stacked Area / Bar Chart)
Revenue Share by Product Category (Donut Chart)

ai_assistant_integration.prompt_modal_or_drawer: Emergent LLM key integration to generate realistic industry sales volume trends, price points, and cost percentages inline.

data_portability.export_csv: Exports both Sales Assumptions Table and Cost Assumptions Table into clean formatted CSV spreadsheet files.
data_portability.export_json_preset: Allows downloading and importing scenario presets in JSON format.
data_portability.in_session_storage: Automatic localStorage caching to prevent data loss on refresh.

component_guidelines.buttons: Primary: bg-[#7AC24A] hover:bg-[#68A73E] text-white font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm. Secondary: border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700. Dark Header Action: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800.
component_guidelines.tables: Must feature sticky first columns (z-20), dark headers (#111827), olive category rows (#EEF3E2), zebra striping on product rows, right-aligned monetary values, and live inline editing input cells.
component_guidelines.inputs: Focus ring ring-2 ring-[#7AC24A] border-slate-300 rounded-md text-sm transition-all.
component_guidelines.cards: Border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow.

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: Must use data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='wizard-next-btn', data-testid='sales-table-header', data-testid='export-csv-btn', data-testid='ai-suggest-btn', data-testid='category-group-prompt').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure theme uses clean White background with primary green #7AC24A accents as explicitly requested.

Ensure the Sales Assumptions Table matches the Google Sheets reference: dark #111827 header row with white text, olive/dark-yellow #EEF3E2 banded category rows, sticky left columns for product/category names and unit prices, and 12 monthly unit volume columns.
Support dynamic auto-grouping prompt when user adds more than 10 products.
Provide quick volume pattern tools: flat fill, linear growth (+%), seasonality (Q4 peak), and AI suggestion.
Integrate Emergent LLM backend API for inline AI suggestions for product prices, unit volumes, and COGS rates based on industry.
Include dynamic Gross Margin Dashboard with Recharts charts (Area, Bar, Pie) and KPI summary metrics.
Provide instant CSV export of both Sales and Cost tables.
Use data-testid on all key interactive elements for robust automated testing.
